The '''Sewing Machine''' is a piece of equipment that can be used to [[Tailoring|tailor]] or [[Dyeing|dye]] clothing. It is received in the mail after completing [[Emily]]'s [[Quests#Rock Rejuvenation|"Rock Rejuvenation"]] special order. It functions the same as the sewing machine at [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|2 Willow Lane]].

If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}.
